summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Taseko Mines Limited (Canadian gold/silver miner) reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held June 24, 2026. Shareholders approved all items including director elections, executive compensation, and a name change to Trekor Metals Limited effective June 25, 2026. The filing is a routine meeting outcome disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer.
